## Introduction


The Lunar New Year marketing ideas for ecommerce brands worth running keep full price and add a reason to buy now. A conditional rebate does that.


Lunar New Year 2027 falls on Saturday, February 6, and opens the Year of the Ram, also called the Year of the Goat or the Sheep.


Shoppers pay full price, get auto-entered, and win 100% of their order back if a real, published event hits during the campaign window.


[Playably](https://playably.ai/) insures and hedges that payout, so you pay $0 of the rebate.


Lunar New Year may matter to a lot of your shoppers, and it deserves more care than a red banner on a sitewide code. The offer should feel like part of the celebration, and the margin should stay where it is.


This guide covers six full-price offers, how they compare with a holiday sale, and the results brands have seen from rebates at full price.


### Key Takeaways


- Lunar New Year marketing ideas for ecommerce brands can hold full price.
- Playably insures and hedges the payout, so you pay $0 of the rebate.
- Build the trigger on a public event, never on cultural symbolism.
- Buckle Me Baby Coats saw sales up 23% and participant AOV up 40%.
- Have someone from the community review your holiday creative.


## Start with respect, then build the offer


Lunar New Year is celebrated by many communities, in many ways. Omnisend's Lunar New Year guide recommends saying "Lunar New Year" rather than "Chinese New Year" so the message includes every community that celebrates, unless you are speaking to one culture specifically.


Get the details right before you get clever. If your team is not part of the community you are speaking to, have someone who is review the creative.


Keep the trigger separate from the holiday's meaning. We would not build a rebate around luck or fortune symbolism, because the holiday is not a gimmick.


The trigger should be a real, public event that anyone can verify. Playably publishes a library of[pre-modelled moments](https://playably.ai/pages/upcoming-offers) across sports, weather and culture, and adds new ones weekly.


## 6 Lunar New Year offers that hold full price


### 1. The gift-order rebate


If your shoppers buy gifts for family and friends at this time of year, put the rebate on the gift order. They pay full price, and if the trigger hits, Playably pays them 100% of their order back by Venmo or PayPal, usually within days.


No code to remember. "They buy, get auto-entered, no code to remember."


The gift lands either way. The rebate is the extra.


### 2. The limited-edition collection


Omnisend's Lunar New Year guide highlights limited-edition collections among its standout ecommerce examples. A limited run already carries its own urgency, so it does not need a markdown on top.


Pair the collection with a rebate and you have two reasons to buy now, at full price. Every collection order is auto-entered.


For more launch structures, see our guide to[product launch promotion ideas](https://playably.ai/blogs/about-gamification/product-launch-promotion-ideas-for-shopify-brands-2026-8-that-sell-at-full-price) .


### 3. The weather trigger


Weather is one of the cleanest triggers there is. It is public, measurable and has no winner or loser.


Playably has published weather moments such as "If ≥1″ of snow falls in New York City on December 25, every campaign order pays back 100%." The same shape can be modelled for a city and a date inside your Lunar New Year window.


Our guide to[weather-triggered promotions for Shopify brands](https://playably.ai/blogs/about-gamification/weather-triggered-promotions-for-shopify-brands-2026-how-free-if-it-snows-works-and-who-pays) walks through how it works.


### 4. The custom trigger


If your shoppers follow a specific public event during the holiday window, bring it to the team.


"Got a different moment in mind? Bring us a trigger we haven't covered."


Playably models the cap for custom triggers too. There is no published price for one, because each is modelled per brand.


The best triggers are events your shoppers are already talking about, which is what makes the campaign spread on its own.


### 5. The gift-guide game


Gift shopping is a question as much as a purchase. A short game helps shoppers find the right thing and tells you what they wanted.


The[PlayAbly app](https://apps.shopify.com/playably) on the Shopify App Store offers swipe-to-shop and product matchup formats, captures email through challenges and tracks engagement in a real time dashboard. It is listed as free.


Every play in a Playably rebate campaign also returns zero party data, feeding segmentation, recommendations and lifecycle flows long after the campaign ends.


### 6. The storefront and event QR


If you sell through retail or show up at community events, take the offer there too. "A QR on the packaging or a POS sign turns any shelf into an entry point."


At events, the entry point is "a code on the jumbotron, a text after kickoff, a card at the gate." The same Play & Win loop runs on site, in playable ads, in store via QR and at live events.


If the holiday sits next to other moments on your calendar,[bundle several triggers](https://playably.ai/pages/bundle-offers) across the season under one plan.
